class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Use Gemini on your Googlebook</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>You can use Gemini to enhance your ideas across your Googlebook. Do things like summarize information, generate images, and work collaboratively using your voice, text, photos, and your device's camera. Gemini serves as a collaborative partner for everything from writing and brainstorming to learning new things or planning a party.</p>

<h2>Availability &amp; Requirements</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>Be 13 or over (or the <a href="https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/1350409" rel="noopener">applicable age in your country</a>). For users under 13, permission is required through <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16109150" rel="noopener">Google Family Link</a>.</li>
  <li>Gemini is available in multiple languages and over 150 countries.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>Before you use Gemini</h2>

<div><ul>
  <li>Don’t rely on Gemini’s responses as medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.</li>
  <li>Responses from Gemini don’t represent Google’s views, and should not be attributed to Google.</li>
  <li>You are responsible for your use of code, which may be subject to an open source license. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/14143489" rel="noopener">Learn more about code and citations</a>.</li>
  <li>Gemini is AI and may give inaccurate or inappropriate information, including about people, so double-check responses. Your feedback makes Gemini Apps more helpful and safe. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13275746" rel="noopener">Learn how to give feedback</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>Use Gemini on Googlebook</h2>

<div>To use Gemini, make sure it’s downloaded on your Googlebook and set Google as your default assistant.</div>

<div><h4><strong>Check your device's default assistant app:&nbsp;</strong></h4>

<ol>
  <li>Open your Googlebook's Settings app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ytBdjpAcSdR2ItDGpWWHdkbOzol3k7eC1klsVRyhclf5pz8IUG_aCJJqwybmeJYRgQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ytBdjpAcSdR2ItDGpWWHdkbOzol3k7eC1klsVRyhclf5pz8IUG_aCJJqwybmeJYRgQ">.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Apps </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;<strong>Default apps</strong>.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>Under "Digital assistant app," check if the app listed is the Google app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Fr8W9wxa4x_Op37pCWFz9juRMRdXlg58W1XVfZfErLdKNhHrsG6EJJwHWMUd7DvMBQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Fr8W9wxa4x_Op37pCWFz9juRMRdXlg58W1XVfZfErLdKNhHrsG6EJJwHWMUd7DvMBQ">.</li>
  <li>If it isn't set as the default:&nbsp;
    <ul>
      <li>Select <strong>Digital assistant app</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;<strong>Default digital assistant app</strong>.&nbsp;</li>
      <li>From the available options, select the Google app <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Fr8W9wxa4x_Op37pCWFz9juRMRdXlg58W1XVfZfErLdKNhHrsG6EJJwHWMUd7DvMBQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Fr8W9wxa4x_Op37pCWFz9juRMRdXlg58W1XVfZfErLdKNhHrsG6EJJwHWMUd7DvMBQ">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><h4><strong>To access Gemini on your Googlebook device:</strong></h4>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p><strong>Open the Gemini app</strong>:&nbsp;On your keyboard, press Action <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/abcM_8Lf8Yq4IFDrSeYHblPCDdb4xELgrge5HW6MwZxYNpVtVQqa6-FdhrYhoasg0IQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Google G icon" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/abcM_8Lf8Yq4IFDrSeYHblPCDdb4xELgrge5HW6MwZxYNpVtVQqa6-FdhrYhoasg0IQ">&nbsp; to find all of your apps. Select Gemini <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.&nbsp;</p>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Open Gemini chat</strong>: Use the keyboard shortcut Action <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/abcM_8Lf8Yq4IFDrSeYHblPCDdb4xELgrge5HW6MwZxYNpVtVQqa6-FdhrYhoasg0IQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="Google G icon" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/abcM_8Lf8Yq4IFDrSeYHblPCDdb4xELgrge5HW6MwZxYNpVtVQqa6-FdhrYhoasg0IQ">&nbsp;+ Space to open Gemini chat.</li>
  <li><strong>Use Gemini in your web browser</strong>: Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com/" rel="noopener">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>With your voice</strong>: Activate Gemini with the "Hey Google" voice command. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/14579631#vm" rel="noopener">Learn how to turn on “Hey Google” and Voice Match</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Use Magic Pointer</strong> to get insights from Gemini by moving your pointer. <a href="https://support.google.com/googlebook?p=magic_pointer" rel="noopener">Learn more about Magic Pointer</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h3>Explore Gemini capabilities on Googlebook</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><p>Gemini provides many features directly on your Googlebook device:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Learn new things through conversational, back-and-forth chats.</li>
  <li>Get help with writing, including grammar correction, summarization, and translation.</li>
  <li>Generate inspiration and visualize plans, such as travel routes on a map.</li>
  <li>Set up repeatable tasks and automations with Gemini Spark.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h3>Get device-specific support</h3>

<div><p>To learn more about how to use your Googlebook, you can ask Gemini. Activate Gemini, then ask questions like, "How do I set up a Bluetooth device on my Googlebook?" Type <span class="green-text">@Googlebook Help</span> to get the most relevant advice.&nbsp;<br>
  <br>
  To talk with Gemini about your Googlebook, make sure the Googlebook Help Connected App is turned on. In Gemini settings, select <strong>Connected Apps</strong> then check that <strong>Googlebook Help</strong> is turned on. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13695044" rel="noopener">Learn more about Connected Apps</a>.&nbsp;</p>
</div>

<h4>Chat Live with Gemini</h4>

<p>Going Live lets you chat conversationally with Gemini. Talk back and forth, brainstorm ideas, and practice aloud. Share your camera and screen to give more context while you chat Live. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/15274899" rel="noopener">Learn more about Gemini Live</a>.&nbsp;To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>

<h3>Automate complex workflows with Gemini Spark</h3>

<p>Gemini Spark is a personal AI agent that can handle complex tasks across your Googlebook. You can ask Spark to do things like organize all the files in a folder or create a custom daily news feed based on your interests. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17094507" rel="noopener">Learn how to get started with Gemini Spark</a>.</p>
